items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: but that was a great little tour there with Trummy, Barney Bigard, Red Calendar bass player, and what the devil is his name, Duke Burrell on piano.

ctx.x: He moved to Honolulu, and he's doing very good out there, he's got a little band; he's working for the Hilton Hotels out there. Been there for year. This year they're going to do another trip for Barry Martyn, May 1st, which I had to cancel out because it was too near me coming out of the hospital, but that was a great little tour there with Trummy, Barney Bigard, Red Calendar bass player, and what the devil is his name, Duke Burrell on piano. And we just had a ball, it was very nice, and that was my second time,…
